title: Admin Panel Structure & Data Sources
purpose: Map all 8 admin panels to their backend routes, services, models, database tables, and access modes (read-only vs read-write)
audience: Backend developers, admin frontend developers, new engineers onboarding, platform maintainers
description: The admin panel consists of 8 distinct panels, all protected by the protectAndAdmin middleware (JWT + admin role). Dashboard (read-only) — GET /admin/dashboard backed by admin.getDashboardStats() querying profiles, transactions, and support_tickets. Users (read-only) — GET /admin/users and /admin/users/:id backed by admin.getAllUsers() and admin.getUserDetails() querying profiles, transactions, and subscriptions. Analytics (read-only) — GET /admin/analytics backed by admin.getAnalytics() querying transactions and analytics_events. Content Moderation (read-write) — GET /admin/content/flagged, POST /admin/content/:id/approve, POST /admin/content/:id/remove backed by admin.getFlaggedContent(), admin.approveContent(), admin.removeContent() querying content and reports. Support Tickets (read-write) — GET /admin/support/tickets, POST /admin/support/tickets/:id/reply, POST /admin/support/tickets/:id/resolve backed by admin.getAllTickets(), admin.replyToTicket(), admin.resolveTicket() querying support_tickets. Reports (read-only) — GET /admin/reports backed by admin.getCustomReport() querying multiple tables via custom query builder. Settings (read-write) — GET /admin/settings and PUT /admin/settings backed by admin.getSettings() and admin.updateSettings() querying platform_settings. Verification Docs (read-only) — GET /admin/users/:id/verification-docs backed by admin.getVerificationDocs() and storage.getPrivateSignedUrl() sourcing from R2 private bucket via profiles.verification_data JSONB.

nodes.label: protectAndAdmin Middleware
nodes.description: Required for all 8 admin panels. Validates JWT and checks admin role. Applied at router level in admin.routes.ts.

nodes.label: Dashboard Panel
nodes.description: Read-only. GET /admin/dashboard. Service: admin.getDashboardStats(). Tables: profiles, transactions, support_tickets. 5 parallel queries.

nodes.label: Users Panel
nodes.description: Read-only. GET /admin/users, GET /admin/users/:id. Service: admin.getAllUsers(), admin.getUserDetails(). Tables: profiles, transactions, subscriptions.

nodes.label: Analytics Panel
nodes.description: Read-only. GET /admin/analytics. Service: admin.getAnalytics(). Tables: transactions, analytics_events.

nodes.label: Content Moderation Panel
nodes.description: Read-Write. GET /admin/content/flagged, POST /admin/content/:id/approve, POST /admin/content/:id/remove. Service: admin.getFlaggedContent(), admin.updateContentStatus(). Tables: content, reports.

nodes.label: Support Tickets Panel
nodes.description: Read-Write. GET /admin/support/tickets, POST /admin/support/tickets/:id/reply, POST /admin/support/tickets/:id/resolve. Service: admin.getAllTickets(), admin.replyToTicket(), admin.resolveTicket(). Tables: support_tickets.

nodes.label: Custom Reports Panel
nodes.description: Read-only. GET /admin/reports. Service: admin.getCustomReport(). Tables: multiple — custom query builder with date range, metric type, and filters.

nodes.label: Platform Settings Panel
nodes.description: Read-Write. GET /admin/settings, PUT /admin/settings. Service: admin.getSettings(), admin.updateSettings(). Tables: platform_settings (key-value store).

nodes.label: Verification Docs Panel
nodes.description: Read-only. GET /admin/users/:id/verification-docs. Service: admin.getVerificationDocs(), storage.getPrivateSignedUrl(). Source: R2 private bucket via profiles.verification_data JSONB file paths.

validationRules: protectAndAdmin middleware required for all 16 admin endpoints
Route-level middleware applied in admin.routes.ts — all sub-routes inherit
Each panel endpoint validates required params specific to its operation
businessRules: 5 of 8 panels are read-only: Dashboard, Users, Analytics, Reports, Verification Docs
3 of 8 panels are read-write: Content Moderation, Support Tickets, Settings
All panels require protectAndAdmin middleware — no public admin endpoints
No admin audit trail exists — no admin_action_log table
Verification Docs panel sources from R2 via 60-second signed URLs (not DB directly)
securityConsiderations: protectAndAdmin enforced at router level — all sub-routes protected
No CSRF protection — admin endpoints rely solely on JWT
No admin audit trail — actions not logged, no accountability
Verification docs contain PII (government ID, selfie) via temporary URLs
Settings panel controls platform-wide configuration — high-impact modifications
User messaging endpoint bypasses normal chat — admins can email any user
performanceConsiderations: Dashboard runs 5 parallel COUNT/SUM queries — heaviest panel
No caching on any panel — each page load queries database
Custom Reports panel may be CPU-intensive for large datasets
User list panel may return many rows — pagination needed
